title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Climate Resilient and Environmentally Sustainable Solutions Somalia/Somaliland (CRESS Somalia/Somaliland) programme will work in Banadir, Somalia and Somaliland. It aims to contribute to Concern Somalia’s Green Graduation and Climate Resilience thematic programmes, and the goal of the grant is to provide inclusive climate resilient and environmentally sustainable livelihood opportunities to vulnerable populations in Banadir. The programme will support over 160,290 people living in extreme poor households including those headed by women, households with disabled members and young people. This will be done through households receive asset/capital transfer to make investment in productive assets in diversified employment activities, households linked to formal financial services and barriers are addressed, environmental restoration and damage mitigation measures are in place and increased awareness on environmental protection and conservation.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: To provide life-saving and life-sustaining multi-sectoral assistance to conflict and natural disaster affected most vulnerable people in Somalia/Somaliland.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: RM Adaptation 1: This outcome promotes Green jobs for the youth that contribute to preserve or restore the environment.DRR 1: HH resilience to shocks or disasters is strengthened as the programme works with formal financial service providers on the risk that people living in conditions of extreme poverty pose as clients and tailoring suitable products and services or establishing bridging structures through community-based savings groups.Aid to Environment 1: Concern’s Green Graduation programme added a 5th pillar to the traditional graduation model - the ‘green’ aspect which aims to improve environmental protection and stability through awareness raising, capacity building, assessing environmental impacts, reducing and managing environmental risks and increasing natural assets.Capacity Building 1: Participants' capacity is built through training such as on financial management, vocational skills, and business skills.Gender Equality 1: : a gender lens is applied at every stage and a gender transformative approach is taken to tackle harmful gender norms, attitudes and practices.Nutrition 1: Through increased financial security and messaging on nutrition, the nutritional status of HHs is improved.
